events.text_en: A blue-crested bird dies of age on the arm of a cinnamon-wood catcher, Tạ, who takes its name, Thanh Loan, and carves its wing into a whistle.
Tuyên Bách Minh, founder of Bách Vũ Các, climbs Triều Phượng Đỉnh at dawn to see the birds bow to the phoenix, and falls.
The dark apes of Huyền Viên Lâm kill Ổ Tùng Lâm of Bách Vũ Các at his parrot nets.
Red-crested writ birds hatch in a hidden loft of Bách Vũ Các from eggs carried out of the Wutong Court's aviary.
